result.summary: This is a narrow urban residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the walkway on the right merges into a large, undefined paved parking area. The environment appears to be low-speed, but it lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure and features several driveway conflict points.

hazards.name: Undefined conflict zone
hazards.description: The large paved area on the right lacks clear separation between the pedestrian walkway and vehicle parking/maneuvering space.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the white building

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalk with obstructions
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and partially obstructed by building steps and tree trunks.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the brick buildings

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway and the right-side parking area could pose a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Delineated Walkway
interventions.description: Use bollards, planters, or distinct paving to clearly separate the pedestrian path from the private parking area on the right.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and paved areas to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a formal place for pedestrians to cross the narrow street.

result.summary: The image shows a mid-block location dominated by a wide driveway or off-street parking area that creates a significant break in the sidewalk continuity. Pedestrians must navigate a large conflict zone where vehicles enter and exit perpendicular to the walkway without physical separation or buffers.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway/Curb Cut
hazards.description: The wide opening for the parking area creates a large unprotected zone where pedestrians are exposed to turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the entire width of the parking area

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers potentially moving within the lot or exiting.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked cars in the center of the frame

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to the minimum necessary for vehicle access to decrease the pedestrian exposure zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Continuity Treatment
interventions.description: Use contrasting materials or a continuous sidewalk level across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install physical barriers at the edge of the sidewalk to prevent vehicle encroachment and clearly define the pedestrian path.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with mixed-use buildings and sidewalks on both sides. While the street appears to have low traffic volumes, it lacks marked pedestrian crossings at the visible intersection and features narrow walkways on the right side.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners can block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side is relatively narrow, which may limit accessibility for some users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban sidewalk adjacent to a brick residential building, featuring mature street trees and parallel on-street parking. A utility pole is situated directly within the paved walkway, creating a physical obstruction that reduces the effective width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A wooden utility pole is located in the center of the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear path for pedestrians and people using mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the sidewalk in front of the brick building

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and any moving traffic in the roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone or underground the utilities to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the nearest intersection to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances, which is particularly important given the visual obstruction from parked cars.
